checks.name: required_assets
checks.requirement: all source, master, data, QA, and archive inputs exist

checks.name: png_600_dpi
checks.requirement: PNG metadata is 600 dpi

checks.name: png_dimensions
checks.requirement: PNG pixels match final size at 600 dpi

checks.name: pdf_one_page
checks.requirement: PDF has one page

checks.name: pdf_dimensions
checks.requirement: PDF matches 177.8 x 124.0 mm

checks.name: svg_vector_text
checks.requirement: SVG is vector and keeps editable text

checks.name: qa_dimensions
checks.requirement: QA surfaces match final print size at 180 dpi

checks.name: grayscale_contrast
checks.requirement: grayscale standard deviation exceeds 20

checks.name: certificate_sigma_grid
checks.requirement: both finite routes use the exact declared ten-case sigma grid

checks.name: certificate_crosscheck
checks.requirement: crosscheck passes and all declared route differences are <= 0.005

checks.name: panel_a_theorem_formula
checks.requirement: Panel A samples exactly the strict full-chain moment barrier

checks.name: finite_moment_barrier
checks.requirement: every finite point respects the exact barrier with declared audit slack

checks.name: finite_certificate_gates
checks.requirement: all finite rows pass and spatial tail is below 1e-18

checks.name: certificate_data_mapping
checks.requirement: all six plotted finite observables per case are exact CSV mappings

checks.name: panel_b_action_diagnostics
checks.requirement: Panel B has positive two-route proxy values and the screened proxy grows

checks.name: panel_c_scalar_ceiling
checks.requirement: Panel C uses the exact ceiling and both finite routes enter the order-one screen

checks.name: panel_d_cubic_diagnostics
checks.requirement: Panel D contains both positive finite normalizations and the square-root ratio decreases

checks.name: claim_role_encoding
checks.requirement: theorem and finite roles are explicit and no finite fit is plotted

checks.name: source_lineage
checks.requirement: all analytic, certificate, contract, and plotting source hashes retain build lineage

checks.name: output_lineage
checks.requirement: all figure outputs retain build hashes

checks.name: public_byte_identity
checks.requirement: public masters are byte-identical to archival masters

checks.name: claim_boundary
checks.requirement: caption and contract separate theorem, diagnostics, logarithmic conjecture, and Clay problem

checks.name: visual_inspection_declared
checks.requirement: final-size, grayscale, and PDF-raster surfaces were explicitly inspected
